_note: Sample builds for the lab's load menu, grouped from beginner twigs to staves. The design doc's worked examples are marked doc: true and double as golden-build tests. spine is handle -> tip. flanks maps gap index (0 = between S1 and S2) to a crystal. A twig has no grip or cap; a plain wand has no cap.

presets.name: A Stick and a Spark
presets.note: Lesson 1: a bare Chalk twig with one Fire crystal.

presets.name: Reed Whistle
presets.note: Two sockets: a fast gust that goes faster.

presets.name: Kettle Twig
presets.note: Lesson 4: two elements side by side fuse. Water core, Fire coat.

presets.name: Apprentice's Tremor
presets.note: A grip adds capacity. Earth + Earth makes a Tremor.

presets.name: Tide Wand
presets.note: A Whalebone grip draws from rain. Try it in the Rain setting.

presets.name: Sparrow Wand
presets.note: A homing Cyclone; the Hollowbone grip charges while you move.

presets.name: Basalt: Earth → Twinspar → Fire
presets.note: Twinspar before Fire: two full lobs, Fire paid twice.

presets.name: Basalt: Earth → Fire → Twinspar
presets.note: Twinspar after Fire: one lob split in two, cheaper.

presets.name: Scalding Lance
presets.note: Fire clashes with Willow and leaves steam mist for free.

presets.name: Wildfire Reaper
presets.note: A Catalyst flank between Fire and Wind. Kills refill the Yew grip.

presets.name: Greed Loop
presets.note: Two feedback loops. One shot is fine; two in a row overload.

presets.name: Golem Breaker
presets.note: A Tidal Wave that bursts. Aim it at the Ember Golem.

presets.name: Inverted Kettle
presets.note: Fire then Water would be a Steam Bomb. The Inverter flips it to a Boiling Jet.

presets.name: Mire Mortar
presets.note: Lobs a mud pool over cover. The Lodestone cap pulls toward armor.

presets.name: Wardbreaker
presets.note: A Cold Iron cap and Earth tear through the Iron Knight's ward.

presets.name: Wisp Hunter
presets.note: Silver cap, Wind and homing. Stronger at night.

presets.name: Ember Gambler
presets.note: Runs hot on purpose. Emberpine turns misfires into fire bursts.

presets.name: Frost Net
presets.note: A Rime cap freezes whatever the Water fan touches.

presets.name: Chalk Marker
presets.note: Hits chalk-mark targets; the next shots curve toward them.

presets.name: Storm Shepherd
presets.note: Three homing Storm Bolts that chain, then echo.

presets.name: Hailstorm Fan
presets.note: Wind core, Water coat: Hail, fanned into three homing shards.

presets.name: Plasma Lance
presets.note: Storm Bolt + Fire = Plasma, a second-order reaction.

presets.name: Sunburst
presets.note: White Flame through a Quartz shaft and a Prism cap. Best by day.

presets.name: Endless Tide
presets.note: Cheap, wet and sustainable: soaks everything it touches.

presets.name: Dragon's Breath
presets.note: Fire counts double in a Dragon Rib shaft.

presets.name: Geyser Staff
presets.note: Fire, Water, Earth: Steam Bomb, then Geyser. Two-handed.

presets.name: Grove Staff
presets.note: Seven sockets. Bouncing earth that bursts into seedlings and echoes.
